Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap and next steps (Redwood & BlueWave)

Hi Alex — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Key goals: reduce inference cost by 30% for patient-facing features; keep p50 latency under 250ms for demo traffic.
- What we promised: sandbox access for a 2-week eval, sample SLO targets, and a non-production test dataset load.
- Action items for BlueWave: confirm procurement contact for vendor onboarding; share preferred timeline for pilot (target start windows: Sep 6 or Sep 20).

Next steps from our side:
1) I’ll send the SOW and a one-page onboarding checklist (attached).
2) Marissa (cc’d) will coordinate vendor setup and finance items — W-9/ACH.
3) We’ll provision sandbox access within 48 hours once procurement gives the green light.

Is one of the two start windows above still realistic for you? If not, share what timing looks like and who on your team will own vendor onboarding.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

1) We need Redwood to provide a completed vendor W-9 (PDF) and detailed instructions for ACH setup. Can you send the W-9 and the bank onboarding checklist?
2) Our finance team also requires a copy of the signed SOW and a Redwood vendor contact (who will be the remitter for invoices).
3) Timeline: once we have completed W-9 and bank details, vendor portal setup typically takes 5 business days. We can prioritize if we receive everything by Sep 2.

Please attach the W-9 and ACH instructions and confirm who will be the finance contact for invoices.
